title: Robot Livery
description: Custom wrap design for R&D video content.

caseStudy.blurb: A custom chest-shell wrap that sets Agility's experimental Digit robots apart from production units on camera, without leaving the brand.
caseStudy.team: Graphic Designer (me), Marketing Team, Sales Team, Innovation Team, Local Wrap Shop
objectives: Make experimental robots instantly distinguishable from production units in video.
Signal a different mode while staying recognizably Agility.
caseStudy.contribution: I researched how other companies signal prototype versus production, iterated on the design with marketing, sales, and innovation teams, and managed the local wrap shop through application and color matching.
results: A clear, camera-ready distinction between production and experimental Digit.
Wrap applied with accurate color reproduction.
Used across Agility's R&D and experimental video content.
